description: Membrane anchor mapping: hydropathy of Q88ND3 and AlphaFold pLDDT/domain boundaries
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q88ND3.fasta",timeout=60).text
SEQ="".join(s.strip().split("\n")[1:])
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19
h=np.array([np.mean([KD[c] for c in SEQ[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(SEQ)-w+1)])
centers=np.arange(w//2+1, len(SEQ)-w//2+1)
top=centers[np.argsort(h)[::-1][:5]]
print("Kyte-Doolittle window=19, top-5 hydrophobic window centres:", sorted(top), " max GRAVY=%.2f"%h.max())
peak=centers[np.argmax(h)]
print(f"single hydrophobic segment centred at residue {peak}; approx span {peak-9}-{peak+9}: {SEQ[peak-10:peak+9]}")
print("N-terminal 30 residues:", SEQ[:30])
print("charge of residues 1-6 (positive-inside rule):", sum(1 for c in SEQ[:6] if c in 'KR'), "basic,", sum(1 for c in SEQ[:6] if c in 'DE'),"acidic")

# AlphaFold model
r=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q88ND3-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120,
               headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
print("AF fetch status",r.status_code, len(r.text))
af=r.text
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
ca={}; plddt={}; allat=[]
for ln in af.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
        num=int(ln[22:26]); nm=ln[12:16].strip()
        xyz=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
        allat.append((nm,num,xyz))
        if nm=='CA': ca[num]=xyz; plddt[num]=float(ln[60:66])
print("AF residues:",len(ca)," mean pLDDT %.1f"%np.mean(list(plddt.values())))
seg=lambda a,b: np.mean([plddt[i] for i in range(a,b+1)])
for a,b,lab in [(1,8,'N-term cytoplasmic tail'),(9,27,'hydrophobic segment'),(28,60,'linker'),
                (61,78,'pre-domain'),(79,265,'SGNH core (crystallised)'),(266,278,'disordered loop'),
                (279,370,'SGNH core 2'),(371,385,'C-term tail')]:
    print(f"  pLDDT {lab} ({a}-{b}): {seg(a,b):.1f}")

ser=[x for n,num,x in allat if num==288 and n=='OG'][0]
# distance from helix axis end to active site
d_helix=[(i,float(np.linalg.norm(ca[i]-ser))) for i in range(1,45)]
print("\nDistance from AF model residue CA to Ser288 OG:")
for i in [1,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,60,78]:
    print(f"   res {i:3d} ({SEQ[i-1]}): {float(np.linalg.norm(ca[i]-ser)):6.1f} A   pLDDT {plddt[i]:.0f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4))
ax[0].plot(centers,h,color='#333'); ax[0].axhline(1.6,ls='--',color='red',lw=0.8)
ax[0].axvspan(peak-9,peak+9,color='orange',alpha=0.3)
ax[0].set_xlabel('residue'); ax[0].set_ylabel('Kyte-Doolittle (w=19)')
ax[0].set_title('AlgJ Q88ND3: one hydrophobic segment, residues %d-%d'%(peak-9,peak+9))
ax[1].plot(sorted(plddt), [plddt[i] for i in sorted(plddt)], color='#4F81BD')
ax[1].axvspan(peak-9,peak+9,color='orange',alpha=0.3,label='hydrophobic anchor')
ax[1].axvspan(79,370,color='green',alpha=0.12,label='crystallised domain (4O8V)')
for p,lab in [(190,'D190'),(192,'H192'),(288,'S288')]:
    ax[1].axvline(p,color='red',lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_xlabel('residue'); ax[1].set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title('AlphaFold confidence, AF-Q88ND3-F1 v6')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
